Tech NoirThe TerminatorTech Noir by night. Big Jeff's by day.Every recipe serves 4.
    StartersMainsSweetsDrinks
    StartersBig Jeff's friesSarah's diner, where she is late for her shiftHow to make it1kg russet potatoes2 L vegetable oilfine salt, to taste1 bottle tomato sauceCut the potatoes into thin fries and soak in cold water.Drain and dry very well.Fry in the vegetable oil at 140°C for the first cook until pale and soft, then lift out and rest.Fry again at 190°C until golden and crisp.Salt straight away and serve with tomato sauce in a squeeze bottle.Tech Noir bar nachosThe club where it all goes downHow to make it300g corn chips400g refried beans (1 tin)200g cheddar, grated1 jar sliced jalapenos200g sour cream1 jar salsaHeat the oven to 200°C. Spread the chips over a tray.Dot with the refried beans and scatter over the cheddar and jalapenos.Bake until the cheese is melted and bubbling.Top with sour cream and salsa and serve at once.MainsBig Jeff's burgerOrder up from the grillHow to make it800g beef chuck mince4 slices of cheddar4 burger buns1/2 iceberg lettuce, shredded2 tomatoes, sliced1 onion, sliced1 jar dill picklessalt and pepper, to tasteShape the mince into four thick patties. Prep the lettuce, tomato, onion and pickles.Season just before cooking and griddle on a hot surface to medium.Lay cheddar on top and cover with a lid until melted.Toast the buns and build the burgers with all the toppings.Kyle's buttermilk fried chicken bucketHoled up at the Tiki MotelHow to make itAs written, serves 4Chicken pieces soaked in buttermilk, dredged in peppery spiced flour and fried crisp, served in a paper-lined bucket with hot sauce and pickles.Soak 1.2kg chicken pieces overnight in 500ml buttermilk with 1 tbsp hot sauce and 2 tsp salt.Mix 250g plain flour with 2 tsp paprika, 2 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp cayenne and 2 tsp pepper.Lift the chicken from the buttermilk, dredge well and rest 10 minutes.Fry in batches at 165°C for 12 to 15 minutes until deep golden and cooked through.Drain on a rack and serve with hot sauce and pickles.SweetsBig Jeff's cherry pieSarah's diner, where she waits tablesHow to make it800g pitted cherries, fresh or frozen150g caster sugar1 lemon3 tbsp cornflour4 sheets of sweet shortcrust pastryHeat the oven to 190°C. Toss the cherries with the sugar, lemon juice and cornflour.Line a pie dish with two pastry sheets and fill with the cherries.Cut the other two sheets into strips and weave a lattice over the top.Bake until deep golden and the filling bubbles. Cool a little before slicing.DrinksTech Noir dark rum Cuba libreDark rum over ice with a full lime squeezed in, topped with cold cola and finished with a dash of bitters, a proper eighties club drink.How to make it2 limes180ml dark rum600ml cola4 dashes of aromatic bitters1 bag iceCut the limes into quarters.Fill four highball glasses with ice and squeeze two lime quarters into each, dropping the shells in.Add the rum and a dash of bitters to each glass, top with cold cola and stir once.
